name: Admin Document Folder Change Client
description: Reassigning a folder's client when it already holds content. The plain PATCH refuses with 409 `folder_has_content` and FolderFormModal raises the conflict instead of swallowing it, so the guided cascade takes over: GET /api/document-folders/:id/change-client/preview/?client_profile_id= names every bucket — the subfolders and documents that move, the issued cuentas de cobro that are never rewritten, and whatever was deliberately assigned to a third client (a subfolder of another client prunes its whole branch) — then the operator picks a mode EVERY time (Pasa también el contenido | Sólo la carpeta, no preselection) and POST /api/document-folders/:id/change-client/ carries the preview's document_ids/folder_ids back as a staleness token, so a 409 records_not_found/records_changed reloads the plan instead of guessing. Clearing the client is deliberately NOT routed here: "nobody" is not a destination the cascade can express, so unassigning a folder is a plain PATCH that leaves its content alone.
knownGaps: Spec added 2026-08-16 with the folder client/project feature: the 409 handoff, the preview buckets, the mode gate and the staleness token over a mocked API.
